tagline: First partner to exceptional teams everywhere
how_built: Fetched independently of the agents: sitemap.xml lists /companies/<slug> and /team/<slug>; records joined from Accel's public Sanity CMS (project 458oembh, dataset production) that the Next.js site renders from.
site_notes: Next.js App Router site (RSC payload in self.__next_f, no __NEXT_DATA__). /companies server-renders only ~200 of 780 companies (A to C, alphabetical); the rest load client-side via filters/infinite scroll. Every company has its own page /companies/<slug> (listed in sitemap.xml). robots.txt disallows /api/. Each company page is ~2MB of HTML, mostly RSC payload.
team_note: Team pages show name, bio and focus sectors; there is no title field in the CMS (people are not labelled Partner/Associate on the site).
